newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains fed cattle sales active at $68 - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains fed cattle sales active at $68 - trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets Monday were active, with sales at $68.00 per cwt, unchanged from last week's top price, feedlot sources said.
About 16,000 head traded in Kansas and 15,000 to 20,000 in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma areas, according to cattle feeders in those areas and USDA.
Demand was moderate, but several feedlots reportedly passed packer bids of $68.00 in hopes of getting $69.00, the sources said.
Prices were underpinned by talk that some packers were short on supplies of slaughter-ready cattle, they said.
